editorNote: Two stories today, both about how a big private-market event is rippling through public holdings: SpaceX's debt-funded AI buildout is dragging on Rocket Lab, and Anthropic's debut has Alphabet's stake in focus. Facts only, no calls.

stories.headline: Rocket Lab has fallen six straight sessions, down about 23%, as SpaceX slips below its IPO price on a lender report
stories.summary: Trefis says Rocket Lab (RKLB) closed at $50.99 on Nov. 19, down 22.9% over a six-day losing streak that erased about $9.9 billion of market value. On Nov. 20, 24/7 Wall St. had SpaceX down 5% at $131.16, below its IPO price, after the Financial Times reported lenders on its debt package sought to bar the financed Nvidia chips from being launched into space; Rocket Lab was down 3% at $49.67.
stories.whyItMatters: Rocket Lab's slide is tracking a sentiment shock in SpaceX's financing, while Trefis says it is mostly company-specific, since the S&P 500 fell 5.8% over the same six sessions.

sourceLinks.title: SpaceX Falls 5%, Breaks Below IPO Price as Lenders Reportedly Balk at Musk's Orbital AI Chip Plans; Rocket Lab Drops 3% - 24/7 Wall St.
A 6-Day Losing Streak Has Rocket Lab Stock Down 23% - Trefis

stories.headline: Alphabet closes down 3.46% at $272.66 on Anthropic's debut day, Yahoo Finance reports
stories.summary: Yahoo Finance's Nov. 19 market wrap has Alphabet (GOOGL) closing at $272.66, down 3.46%, even as Anthropic's Nasdaq debut put a fresh market value on Google's stake. The article describes the holding as nearly 14% and estimates it at about $175 billion, noting Google is close to its 15% ownership cap.
stories.whyItMatters: A listed price now exists for a large part of Alphabet's balance-sheet exposure to Anthropic, but the stock did not rise with it that day.

sourceLinks.title: Stock Market Today, Nov. 19: Alphabet Shares Fall as Anthropic Nasdaq Debut Puts Fresh Value on Google's Stake - Yahoo Finance
